source.publication: 2025 Schedule M1R, Age 65 or Older/Disabled Subtraction
source.section: Form M1 lines 1-4, 7-10 (instructions PDF p.13 Standard Deduction Table for Line 4, p.14 Worksheet A, p.39 Tax Rate Schedules, pp.32-38 tax table); Schedule M1R lines 1-13 and Line 10 table (M1R PDF p.1, p.2); Form M1 instructions PDF p.15; M1M PDF p.5 line 16; Schedule M1M line 1 (M1M PDF p.3 'Line 1 - Interest From Municipal Bonds of Another State')

worked: Joint, one spouse 66, one 60; AGI under 14,500, so both line 10 figures give the full 12,000. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution 14,000.00 = 14,000.00. Federal taxable income = 14,000.00 - 33,100.00 federal standard deduction (31,500 plus 1 x 1,600) = below zero, so 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form M1, married filing jointly: line 1 federal AGI 14,000.00. Schedule M1M line 1 other-state municipal interest 40,000.00; line 10 additions 40,000.00; Form M1 line 2 40,000.00; line 3 = 54,000.00. Schedule M1R: line 1 12,000.00; line 2 0.00 (65 or older); line 3 12,000.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 nontaxable Social Security 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00; line 6 Railroad Retirement Board benefits 0.00; line 7 0.00; line 8 = 12,000.00. Line 9 14,000.00; line 10 14,500.00 (joint, one spouse 65 or older); line 11 0.00; line 12 0.00; line 13 = 12,000.00. Schedule M1M line 40 = Form M1 line 7 subtractions = 0.00 + 12,000.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 12,000.00 (lines 12, 16, 17, 25). State income before deduction = 54,000.00 - 12,000.00 = 42,000.00. Standard Deduction Table for Line 4 (PDF p.13): base 29,900.00 plus 1 x 1,550 age box(es) = 31,450.00; AGI is not over 238,950.00, so no Worksheet A. Line 4 = 31,450.00. Form M1 line 8 total = 31,450.00 + 12,000.00 = 43,450.00; line 9 Minnesota taxable income = 54,000.00 - 43,450.00 = 10,550.00. Line 10 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.39): 5.35% x (10,550.00 - 0.00) = 564.425 = 564.425. The tax table (PDF pp.32-38) gives 564; expected keeps the schedule formula. Line 16 credits 0.00 (the joint-filer Schedule M1C credit is not in the sources and is not applied); state income tax 564.43.
accepted_approximations: Tax comes from the rate schedules at every income; below 86,800 of taxable income the booklet requires its 100-wide tax table.
The Schedule M1C credit for joint filers is not applied because its amount is not in the sources.
